budgetNotes.v4-rad-scoping: The selected-root RAD binding raised the readable package output to 3,442 gzip bytes. Minified ESM measures 2,749, so the existing 3,000-byte package ceiling is retained. Consumer budgets count the complete selected RAD bundle and CSS separately; no runtime/consumer threshold was relaxed.
budgetNotes.v4-component-packaging: The independently importable control entry points, shared chunks, explicit application owner and keyboard/teardown fixes measured 11,003 gzip bytes across every package JS file before the esbuild update. The package/archive inventory ceiling is 12,000; this is not a consumer download budget. The v4 essential JS/CSS budgets remain 24,000/10,000 and the full browser ceiling stays 148,000. Per-consumer graphs and sizes are tested separately.
budgetNotes.v3-foundation: The v3 alpha includes complete typed component metadata, unified resource and hydration ownership, capability groups, a diagnostic compatibility build, generated contracts, versioned token and locale modes, SBOM/provenance, and the completed security and agent foundations. Core remains below 33 KB gzip and the alpha compatibility bundle remains below 148 KB gzip; profile imports remain the production recommendation.
